observability_triage.rationale: The revised placement is observable from placed connector courtyards and the closed Edge.Cuts polygon: the USB-C and battery connector can be associated with their nearest parallel board edges and required to occupy opposite edge zones. Existing mounting-hole clearance remains a measurable PCB geometry regression.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The battery connector and USB-C connector occupy opposite parallel edge zones of the PCB: each connector courtyard is closest to a different outline segment and those two segments have opposite outward normals; both courtyards remain within the board envelope except the permitted USB shell protrusion.

observables.surface: dist/design.kicad_pcb connector placement relative to Edge.Cuts
setup: Build the PCB and resolve USB-C and battery connector courtyard/body polygons.

expected_observations.subject: USB-C nearest edge equals battery connector nearest edge
dot product of the two normalized edge outward normals
battery connector courtyard contained by board outline

determinism_controls: Use transformed footprint geometry in millimetres.
Do not infer placement from model prose or reference order.

setup: Both connectors sit near the same or adjacent board edge.
negative_cases.action: Compute nearest edge segments and normals.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails even when their coordinate distance is large.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The relocated battery connector courtyard does not intersect any mounting-hole drill, copper, or keep-out envelope.

setup: Resolve placed battery courtyard and all mounting-hole envelopes.

expected_observations.subject: battery connector to mounting-hole envelope intersections
